memories.author: D04
memories.text: - Depression: status: new onset low mood, anhedonia, PHQ-9 15/27, no suicidal ideation. plan: start sertraline 50 mg OD after breakfast, monitor PHQ-9 in 4 weeks, weight 68 kg, waist 78 cm (male cutoff 90 cm OK). diet advice: breakfast - include protein and fibre; lunch - balanced plate with veg; dinner - light, avoid heavy carbs.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: - Depression: status: improved mood, PHQ-9 10/27, reports better sleep, mild daytime fatigue. plan: increase sertraline to 100 mg OD after breakfast, repeat PHQ-9 in 4 weeks, weight 69 kg, waist 80 cm (still OK). diet advice: breakfast - add nuts; lunch - include legumes; dinner - soup + salad.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Feeling better most days, occasional trouble falling asleep, no side effects from meds.
